Hager uncovers a troubling link between a local biker gang, the Aujay disappearance, and members of the LASD. To address this, a covert task force involving the DEA is launched.
stichpunkte: Detective Brandenburg investigates the Aujay case with narcotics detective Darren Hager
Hager works to dismantle a meth syndicate operated by a local biker gang
Discovery of a connection between the biker gang, Aujay's disappearance, and LASD colleagues
Involvement of the DEA in establishing a covert task force
beschreibung:
As Detective Brandenburg follows leads in the Aujay case, he finds himself with an unlikely ally. A young buck narcotics detective named Darren Hager, who’s trying to dismantle a meth syndicate run by a local biker gang. Hager discovers that his bikers have a disturbing connection to Aujay’s disappearance — and to some of his own LASD colleagues. So he brings in the big guns, the Drug Enforcement Administration, and they launch a covert task force.
